name: advanced-memory
description: The memory implant of the QuoxMind cognitive suite. Persistent storage, semantic search, working set memory, truth arbitration, and style learning. Free tier provides basic storage; Pro unlocks vector search, WSM, and promotion.
shortDescription: QuoxMind memory implant. Semantic search, WSM, style learning, truth arbitration.
author: QUOX
marketingPoints: Your AI finally remembers who you are
Import years of ChatGPT conversations in minutes
Semantic search finds memories by meaning, not keywords
AI adapts to your communication style automatically
Never repeat yourself - your AI knows your preferences

unlimitedMemory.name: Unlimited Memory Storage
unlimitedMemory.description: Store unlimited facts, preferences, decisions, and learned items. Free version limits you to just 10 memories.

semanticSearch.name: Semantic Search
semanticSearch.description: Find memories by meaning, not just keywords. Ask 'what did I say about deployment?' and get relevant results even if you never used that word.

styleEngine.name: Style Engine
styleEngine.description: Your AI learns how you communicate - formal vs casual, verbose vs concise, technical vs simple. It adapts to match your preferences.

beliefMemory.name: Belief & Rationale Memory
beliefMemory.description: Track the difference between facts, beliefs, assumptions, and hypotheses. Your AI knows what it knows vs what it thinks.

failureMemory.name: Failure Memory
failureMemory.description: Remember what didn't work and why. Your AI learns from mistakes and warns you before repeating them.

wsm.name: Working Set Memory
wsm.description: Track open loops, active projects, recent entities, and current context across sessions. Your AI remembers what you're working on.

chatgptImport.name: ChatGPT Import
chatgptImport.description: Import your entire ChatGPT conversation history. Years of context, preferences, and decisions - extracted and made searchable.

contradictionDetection.name: Contradiction Detection
contradictionDetection.description: Automatically detect and resolve conflicting memories. Your AI maintains a consistent worldview.

extendedContext.name: Extended Context Window
extendedContext.description: 8x larger context budget (4000+ tokens vs 500 free). More memories injected into every conversation.

memoryVisualization.name: Memory Visualization
memoryVisualization.description: Timeline, knowledge graph, and heatmap views of your memories. See how your AI's brain is organized.

unlimitedPreferences.name: Unlimited Preferences
unlimitedPreferences.description: Store as many preferences as you want. Free version limits you to just 3.

autoSavePreferences.label: Auto-Save Preferences
autoSavePreferences.description: Automatically learn and save user preferences from conversations

contextTokenLimit.label: Context Token Limit
contextTokenLimit.description: Maximum tokens to include from memory in each request

semanticSearchThreshold.label: Search Relevance Threshold
semanticSearchThreshold.description: Minimum similarity score for memory search results (lower = more results)

enableStyleEngine.label: Style Engine
enableStyleEngine.description: Learn and adapt to your communication style over time

retentionDays.label: Memory Retention (days)
retentionDays.description: How long to keep episodic memories before archiving

testimonials.quote: Finally, an AI that actually remembers our infrastructure setup.
testimonials.author: DevOps Engineer

testimonials.quote: Imported 2 years of ChatGPT history. It's like giving my AI all my institutional knowledge.
testimonials.author: Technical Lead
